Thai Steak Noodle Salad
Seared Steak · Mango · Avocado · Peanuts · Thai Vinaigrette
The Story

Marinated, seared steak with kale, mango, tomato, avocado, peanuts, carrot, and a fresh herb mix — cilantro, mint, basil. Tossed in Thai vinaigrette.

Thai cooking is built on four flavors in balance — sweet, sour, salty, spicy. The vinaigrette delivers all four; the herbs and peanuts carry it through. The steak makes it a meal.

A classic on the Grilles menu. Built fresh every time — never pre-tossed, never sitting. Mango and herbs cut to order.
